name: auto-mcs
description: auto-mcs is a cross-platform Minecraft server manager that creates and runs servers (Vanilla, Paper, Fabric, Forge, and more) in under a minute, with mod/plugin management, automatic backups, and a scripting console. This container exposes the auto-mcs interface as a web terminal (ttyd) on the Web UI port. Manage everything from your browser — no desktop client needed. SECURITY: This template requires you to set a Web UI Password at install (the upstream default is root / auto-mcs — don't use it). The web terminal grants shell access inside the container, so keep it on your LAN unless you've secured it. PORTS: 8080 is the web UI, 7001 is the Telepath remote-management API, and 25565 is the default port for the Minecraft server auto-mcs runs. auto-mcs opens a new port for every server you create — if you plan to run more than one, set Network Type to "host" so you don't have to add a port mapping for each. TIP: If Crafty Controller or another Minecraft server already uses port 25565, change the host port here to something free (e.g. 30000).

paths.name: App Data
paths.description: auto-mcs configuration, all managed servers, world files, and backups.

ports.name: Web UI Port
ports.description: Browser interface (ttyd web terminal). Change only the host (left) side if 8080 is already in use; leave the container side at 8080.

ports.name: Minecraft Server Port
ports.description: Default port for the Minecraft server auto-mcs runs. Change the host port if Crafty or another server already uses 25565. Add more port mappings for additional servers.

ports.name: Telepath API Port
ports.description: Optional Telepath remote-management API. Only expose this if you use Telepath; keep it off your WAN.

variables.name: WEB_USERNAME
variables.description: Username for the web UI login. Default: root.

variables.name: WEB_PASSWORD
variables.description: Password for the web UI login. Set a strong password here (the upstream default is 'auto-mcs' — do not use it). The web terminal is a root shell inside the container.

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Timezone for log timestamps, e.g. America/New_York. Defaults to UTC.
